changes.intro: We're Dagger & Bone Apothecary, a men's hair, skin, and body-care brand based in St. Augustine, Florida. Josh, our founder, is developing our first collection.
changes.body:
We think grooming should leave you free to be yourself. Taking care of your hair and skin, or choosing a scent you like, shouldn't come with a lecture about what makes you a man.

Nobody needs to prove anything to a bottle of conditioner.
